_comment: UNVERIFIED — see docs/CLIENT_COMPATIBILITY.md. Gemini CLI's BeforeTool hook surface is documented in the gemini-cli repo (docs/hooks/reference.md), but this file has never been fired in a live Gemini session from this repo. Treat it as a proposed port, not a demonstrated guard: if you run Gemini CLI here, verify it blocks a `gh pr merge` before relying on it, and update the CLIENT_COMPATIBILITY hooks table.
_naming_note: Gemini calls the pre-tool event BeforeTool, not PreToolUse, and its shell tool run_shell_command, not Bash. Both differ from Claude Code and Codex, which is why this is a separate config rather than a copied one.
_timeout_note: timeout is milliseconds here, unlike Claude Code and Codex where it is seconds. 30000 = 30s, matching the other two.

hooks.name: pr-merge-guard
hooks.description: Require tools/safe-pr-merge.sh instead of a direct gh pr merge

_matcher_note: matcher is '.*' on purpose — see the same note in .codex/hooks.json. Pinning it to run_shell_command would break silently if Gemini adds or renames a shell tool; the script's tool_input.command check is the single place that decides.
